text: {"lessons":["I repeatedly sold Stock A to lock in large gains, but that satisfaction may have made me sell for emotional reasons rather than because its future prospects changed.","A gain relative to my average cost is not, by itself, a reason to sell; I should weigh each holding against risk, diversification, and my investment plan.","Prices are unpredictable, and a few periods of account gains or losses do not establish a trend, so I should avoid reacting to short-term moves."]}
